closest_works.citation: Correia 2021, A kind route from grounding to fundamentality
closest_works.shared_claim: Coarse kinds can be reciprocally grounded while instances form an alternating hierarchy. Weak initial candidate rejected.
closest_works.difference: No-infinite-chain countermodel plus necessity and sufficiency of uniform finite depth for ANY finite edge-preserving acyclic refinement. Not a refutation of Correia’s restricted foundation relation.

closest_works.citation: Mirsky 1971, A Dual of Dilworth’s Decomposition Theorem
closest_works.shared_claim: Finite-height orders admit a finite antichain decomposition; mathematical core is established.
closest_works.difference: Claimed increment is the diagnosed metaphysical commitment of complete finite charts and the inability of finite-refinement failure to establish circularity or infinitism; mathematical novelty expressly disclaimed. Independent critic must assess whether this philosophical increment is sufficient.

closest_works.citation: Rabin and Rabern, Well Founding Grounding Grounding
closest_works.shared_claim: Different senses of termination/foundation must be distinguished.
closest_works.difference: Uniform finite depth is isolated as the exact condition for finite strict chart representation, stronger than all individual chains being finite.

closest_works.shared_claim: Acyclic structures can produce cyclic abstractions.
closest_works.difference: Quantification over every finite refinement, a purely finite-chain countermodel, and resulting metaphysical inference constraint. No transfer of intervention semantics to grounding.
